named-query.name: Expedicao.listarPorPeriodoESituacao
named-query.query: select e.codigo, e.titulo, c.nome, e.inicioPrevisto, e.terminoPrevisto, e.situacao from Expedicao e join e.caverna c where e.inicioPrevisto between :inicio and :fim and e.situacao = :situacao order by e.inicioPrevisto, e.codigo

named-query.name: Participacao.listarPorExpedicaoComPessoa
named-query.query: select p from Participacao p join fetch p.pessoa where p.expedicao.id = :expedicaoId order by p.pessoa.nome

named-query.name: Coleta.listarPorExpedicao
named-query.query: select c from Coleta c join fetch c.setor join fetch c.pesquisador where c.expedicao.id = :expedicaoId order by c.dataHora

named-query.name: Amostra.listarPorColeta
named-query.query: select a.id, a.codigoCampo, a.categoria, a.quantidade, a.unidade, a.dataAcondicionamento, a.condicaoConservacao, a.materialPerigoso, a.observacoes from Amostra a where a.coleta.id = :coletaId order by a.codigoCampo
